title: Soundness of the movement reader
statement: For any bit string $x$, head movement $s\in\{-1,0,1\}$, and suffix $r$, if the movement reader applied to $x$ returns $s$ and $r$, then $x$ is the two-bit code for $s$ followed by $r$.
hypotheses_covered: The movement reader succeeds on x and returns (s,r)
replaced:
If the head-movement reader succeeds on a bit string $x$, returning a movement
$s$ and a suffix $r$, then $x$ is exactly the two-bit dictionary code of $s$
followed by $r$.
